headline_findings: Phase 9 blocker is independent of Phase 8: task 510's modalExpandBranchesGen_hintikka (CompletenessLoop.lean:876) requires RuleApplicationSpec + ModalLoopInvGen (rank fields + geomCap phiBound) + modalExpMeasure over modalUniverse (K). S4 provably cannot supply any of these. 510 generalized the rule slot, NOT the termination measure. The 506 plan's Task-510 Gate checked the conclusion type (which does align, rfl) but not the hypotheses (the real obstruction).

Both Phase 8 gaps confirmed and shown structural: worldSetsDistinct over the live branch is provably not a loop invariant. Relevant sets grow monotonically, so distinctness has no forward-stable witness (Gap 1, persistent-step collapse); and blockingWorld checks the source world's set, not the prospective successor's birth content (Gap 2). Fix requires stating the invariant over stable birth-key data, not the live branch.

Exponent mismatch: modalWorldBoundS4 = 2^|Sf| is too small. sameRelevantSet distinguishes signs, so the pigeonhole codomain is powerset(Sign x Sf), card 2^(2|Sf|). Bump modalWorldBoundS4 to 2^(2*|Sf|); decidability needs only a finite computable bound.

recommended_design.guard: blockingWorldS4: block iff an existing known world's CURRENT relevant set equals the PROSPECTIVE successor birth content (successorBirthContent), not the source's set.
recommended_design.invariant: Option A (recommended): thread per-world stable birth keys; S4LoopInv fields keysTotal/keyLowerBd(subset of live relevant set)/keysDistinct/keysInUniverse. Monotone-stable because keys never change and live sets only grow.
recommended_design.fallback: Option B: restate distinctness only for saturated worlds (no driver change, looser bound, harder fuel-sufficiency).
recommended_design.pigeonhole: Inject known worlds into powerset(Sign x Sf) via injective key map; Finset.card_powerset (=2^card), Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn / List.Nodup.length_le_card. All confirmed present in Mathlib.
